Hullo morning crew,
The kennel attendant sent an update on rest areas

Please keep the companion bays calm, tidy, and ready for handover, and make sure each crate check is recorded clearly in the shift notes. <<FACT F040>> If a traveler arrives with special handling needs, coordinate at once with the ramp lead and the service desk so the pet can move through the process without avoidable delay. Use steady language with customers, confirm identification calmly, and watch that water bowls remain secure and clean.

For today, please give extra attention to carry cases that look crowded or show signs of stress from transit. If you are supporting a cat or dog in the holding area, speak softly, limit unnecessary movement, and keep the surrounding space free of clutter. The Companion Animal Travel Desk relies on precise follow-through, so report any concern immediately rather than waiting for the next round. Keep me informed of any change in comfort, behavior, or paperwork, and share updates with the team as soon as they are available. Thank you for maintaining the steady standard that Aurelia Skyways expects from this desk.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
